GenAiFunction.description: Shows the customer the Business Enquiry form. The customer registers the enquiry inside the form with its own Submit Request button; when the customer then clicks the chat Submit button, this action confirms the registration and returns the status, the reference number and the exact message to show the customer. It never creates a case itself. Use it whenever the customer wants to raise a new business enquiry. Never ask for pincode, mobile number, email, name, designation or organisation in chat - the form collects them.
